Counsel for the State has filed a counter affidavit.

In the said counter affidavit the report of the Forensic Science Laboratory, Chandigarh, is annexed and subsequently, the investigating officer has proceeded further on the basis of the report of the Forensic Science Laboratory, Chandigarh.
In this view of the matter that on the basis of the statement of the victim given by her in the hospital the investigation continued.

In this background, this Court is disposing off this writ petition directing to the authorities concerned, particularly, the Senior Superintendent of Police, Muzaffarpur (respondent no. 5) to himself supervise this case and then only submit the final report under Section 173(2) of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
With this direction, this writ petition is disposed off.

(Dr. Anshuman, J) Shamshad/-
